🌍 World History · Level 1, Level 2 & Level 3 (inclusion)

🔵 Level 1Basic + Advanced inside🟣 Level 2About 5th–6th-grade reading🟢 Level 3Close to class · guided notes

Showing all levels. Tap a button to switch.

Modified Level 1 (Basic + Advanced), Level 2 and Level 3 materials for students in the World History class. Students stay in the gen ed lesson and use these pieces next to it: same units, same order, same points. Every notes page and reading has a 🔊 Read aloud button.

🗂️ Units 👩‍🏫 Teacher resources

🗂️ Units in course order

Same units and order as the gen ed class. 14 of 14 ready. Tap a unit to show it below.

Unit 1🌍 Geography & World ReligionsUnit 2🕌 Muslim EmpiresUnit 3🎨 The RenaissanceUnit 4🪖 World War IUnit 5🚩 The Russian RevolutionUnit 6💸 Between the WarsUnit 7✈️ World War IIUnit 8🕊️ Genocide & Human RightsUnit 9🧱 Cold War, China & IndiaUnit 10⛪ The ReformationUnit 11💡 The EnlightenmentUnit 12🇫🇷 The French RevolutionUnit 13🌎 Latin American RevolutionsUnit 14🏭 The Industrial Revolution

🌍 Unit 1: Geography & World Religions

Continents, oceans, the equator and map types. Five big world religions: Hinduism, Judaism, Buddhism, Christianity and Islam (plus Sikhism), with their symbols, holy books and places.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 1 (start of year): Free Hand Map pre-test + map debrief slides, Religion pre-quiz, Religion Packet (Hinduism, Judaism, Buddhism, Christianity, Islam), Faith & Belief video sheet (World Religions Movie), Religious Symbols / Religion Mobile Project, Religions Unit Test”.

Level 1 Basic 2nd-grade reading: pictures and emoji, one idea at a time

🕌 Unit 2: Muslim Empires

Three Muslim empires (about 1300-1700): the Ottomans (Constantinople, Suleiman, janissaries), the Safavids (Persia, art and rugs) and the Mughals (India, Akbar, the Taj Mahal). Cultural blending.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 2 Muslim Empires: pre-quiz, Ottoman Summary, Ottoman Leaders chart (Suleiman DBQ, janissaries), Ottomans & Safavids easy read, Safavid Summary, PBS Safavid + Khan Academy Safavid Art Search, Persian rug sketch, Cultural Blending worksheet, Mughal reading, Secrets of the Taj Mahal video sheet, Muslim Empires Test”.

🎨 Unit 3: The Renaissance

A 'rebirth' of Greek and Roman ideas that began in Italy (about 1350-1600). Florence and the Medici, humanism, the printing press, and art by Leonardo, Michelangelo and Raphael (perspective, fresco, sfumato).
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 3 Renaissance (current, starts 11/3): pre-quiz, Italy Summary / Cradle of the Renaissance reading, Medieval vs. Renaissance art note sheet (2018Renaissanceart slides), Crash Course World History: The Renaissance video sheet, Ted Ed video + bookwork, School of Athens (Khan Academy), Leonardo & Michelangelo chart, Renaissance Review Hunt slides, quiz”.

Level 1 Basic 2nd-grade reading: pictures and emoji, one idea at a time

🪖 Unit 4: World War I

1914-1918. The MAIN causes (militarism, alliances, imperialism, nationalism), the spark in Sarajevo, the alliance 'domino effect', trench warfare and new weapons, and the Treaty of Versailles.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 4 World War I: Causes of WWI video sheet (MAIN causes, the spark, domino effect), WWI weapons slides (new technology, stalemate), Sgt Stubby videos, Edgenuity WWI lessons, Treaty of Versailles / Wilson's 14 Points sheet, Kahoot”.

🚩 Unit 5: The Russian Revolution

1917: the end of the tsars (Nicholas II), Lenin and the Bolsheviks ('Peace, Land and Bread'), Marx's communism, the civil war (Red vs. White Army), and Stalin's totalitarian rule.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 5 Revolutions in Russia: Marx & Lenin compare (Communist Manifesto, Venn diagram), Russian Revolution Dynasty slides + Bolshevik questions (Bolsheviks, Red/White Army, communism, Mensheviks, Lenin, Trotsky, Stolypin, Kerensky, 'pick a side'), Rule of Stalin textbook reading (totalitarianism), Edgenuity lessons”.

💸 Unit 6: Between the Wars

1919-1939. Germany's money becomes worthless (hyperinflation), the Great Depression, and the rise of dictators: Hitler in Germany, Mussolini in Italy and military leaders like Tojo in Japan.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 6 Years of Crisis: Global Economic Crisis reading + questions (German inflation, 'stacks o' money'), Japanese Militarism reading + questions (Hideki Tojo), Edgenuity lessons on the Great Depression and the rise of dictators”.

✈️ Unit 7: World War II

1939-1945. Hitler takes land, Germany invades Poland, blitzkrieg, Dunkirk and the Battle of Britain, Pearl Harbor, D-Day, the Pacific war, the atomic bombs, and VE and VJ Day.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 7 World War II: How did WWII start & Key Battles sheet (Munich Agreement, Nazi-Soviet pact, Dunkirk, Churchill, RAF + radar, Operation Barbarossa, scorched earth, blitzkrieg; FDR & Churchill strategy, Battle of the Bulge, Iwo Jima & Okinawa, island hopping, VE/VJ Day), Battles of World War II slides, The Atomic Bomb video sheet (Manhattan Project, Hiroshima & Nagasaki, radiation sickness), Edgenuity lessons”.

🕊️ Unit 8: Genocide & Human Rights

How hate grows into genocide: the Holocaust (1933-1945), the Armenian Genocide (1915), apartheid in South Africa (1948-1994) and the genocide in Rwanda (1994). Human rights, upstanders and remembering the victims.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 8 Genocide: The Path to Nazi Genocide (USHMM film + 15 questions; Honors version), Armenian Genocide assignment (Britannica video, timelines, survivor stories, UN definition), South African Apartheid / Rwandan Genocide (Britannica apartheid pages, rwandanstories.org)”.

🧱 Unit 9: Cold War, China & India

After 1945: the Cold War between the USA (capitalism, democracy) and the USSR (communism), the Iron Curtain, NATO, the Berlin Airlift and Wall; Mao and communist China; Gandhi, independence and partition in India.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 9 After WWII: Cold War Personalities, Terms & Events slides + 1950s Terms & Personalities sheet (communism, capitalism, Truman, Marshall Plan, Iron Curtain, domino theory, containment, NATO, Warsaw Pact, Rosenbergs, Berlin Airlift, Mao, McCarthy), How did communism start in China video sheet, Reeducation under Mao (Five-Year Plans, Cultural Revolution, Red Guards), Indian Independence Review (Gandhi, partition, Nehru, Jinnah, Indira Gandhi)”.

⛪ Unit 10: The Reformation

Martin Luther and the 95 Theses (1517), the printing press, Calvin, Henry VIII and the Church of England, the Counter-Reformation and how Western Christianity split.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “Unit 4 The Reformation (class Canvas): Martin Luther, Luther Challenges the Church, The Reformation Spreads, Henry VIII & the Church of England, Counter-Reformation, Effects of the Reformation”.
